levels.surface: ذريح بن يزيد بن محمد المحاربي

notes: Two statements of routes («رويته عن أبي ...») to the book of Dhurayh, with no saying: needs_ruling (rule 11).
«أبي» and «أبيه» with no name are relations (rule 7); «علي بن إبراهيم» is the same name in both routes.
«ذريح» stands three times; the last is the chain's own. The blessing «رضي الله عنه» is left out.
